newsitem.title: UK: IPAI unable to report Iran aluminium data.
newsitem.headline: IPAI unable to report Iran aluminium data.

text.p: The International Primary Aluminium Institute (IPAI) said on Thursday that it was unable to include Iranian data on production and stocks in its statistics until further notice.
"...since the beginning of the year the Iranian Aluminium Co (IRALCO) has discontinued its regular confidential reporting of production, inventory and capacity figures to the IPAI," it said.
Thus, published figures for January, February and months thereafter do not contain any information or estimates for Iran.
"It is hoped the break in the supply of data will prove to be temporary. Users will be informed as soon as it is possible once more to include data from Iran," the IPAI said.
